purpose: Teach: レーン/バラード/アサ/ファイア/台場/ハロ/冴え/エッジ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、放課後、本気で、絶対、ボーリングのレーン、皆で、絶対、行こうよ、本気で、絶対、楽しいよ
lines.en: Riku, we have to go bowling after school. I'm serious—let's all go together. It'll be so fun!
lines.style: Bright, insistent energy. Quick, overlapping delivery like she can't contain the excitement. Light pressure on 'have to' and 'I'm serious.' Lean forward slightly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。卒業式、本気で、絶対、バラードの曲、絶対、流れるんだろうな、桜、お互いに、感動、本気で、絶対、本気、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Yeah. During the graduation ceremony... there'll probably be ballad music playing, you know? Sakura, we'll... we'll probably both get really emotional about it.
lines.style: Softer, more internal. He's thinking ahead, a little vulnerable. Slight hesitation on the repeated words — he's testing whether it's okay to admit he's looking forward to this. Warm undercurrent despite the distance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 生物の授業で、本気で、絶対、アサの観察、絶対、面白かったよね、リク、お互いに、本気で、絶対、勉強になった、本気、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: In bio class, remember how interesting the morning glory observations were? We really learned so much from doing that together, didn't we?
lines.style: Animated, reminiscing warmth. She's bringing up a good memory and wants him to feel included in it. Bright but genuine—not performing, just pleased. Light rhythm, natural enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭で、本気で、絶対、ファイアパフォーマンス、絶対、見たいよな、桜、お互いに、本気で、絶対、楽しみ、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: I really want to see the fire performance at the culture festival, you know? Sakura, I'm looking forward to it—we both will be, I'm sure.
lines.style: A little softer than eager, but sincere underneath. He's revealing he's thought about this, looking forward to something with her. The repetition isn't stuttering—it's him settling into genuine excitement once he lets himself say it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夏休み、本気で、絶対、お台場、絶対、家族で、行く予定なんだ、リク、お前も、本気で、絶対、楽しんでね
lines.en: Over summer break we're planning to go to Odaiba with my family. You should come and have a good time too, okay?
lines.style: Bright invitation, light and confident. She's including him naturally, without making it a big deal. Quick pace, genuine warmth. The 'okay?' lands like she actually wants to know he'll be there.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ハロウィン、本気で、絶対、皆で、絶対、衣装、本気で、絶対、合わせよう、桜、本気で、絶対、楽しみだぜ、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Halloween—let's all match our costumes together, yeah? Sakura, I'm really excited about that, seriously.
lines.style: Eager, almost giddy. He's building momentum with each phrase. The repetition reads as genuine excitement bubbling over, not uncertainty. Lean-in confidence. End with a slight upward lilt, like he wants confirmation she's as excited as he is.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、冴え冴えとした、判断、絶対、するよね、本当に、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: You know, Riku, you really do make sharp, clear-headed judgments. I'm genuinely impressed by that about you.
lines.style: Sincere admiration, direct eye contact in the voice. She means this—no sarcasm mask. Warm and steady. Slight emphasis on 'you'—she's specifically talking about him, not generic praise.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の話、本気で、絶対、エッジの効いた、視点、絶対、面白いよな、桜、本気で、絶対、感心、本気、本気で、本気で、本当に、絶対、本気。
lines.en: The things you say—you have such an edgy, interesting perspective on things. Sakura, I really do admire that about you.
lines.style: Genuine warmth with slight surprise at his own honesty. He's admiring her back, a little self-conscious about being sincere. Softer than his usual cool distance. The repetition lands as him double-checking that it's okay to say nice things.
